name: Halts & LULD
parallel_note: Independent data path. No shared artifact, no dependency in either direction.
_note: Every [Cooper] value is UNFILLED BY DESIGN. Escalation row 2 hard-stops T0c if any remain unfilled in the committed file. The LULD band table is the most important of them.

_corrections_on_landing._who: landed from the handoff paste; no threshold filled, no band parameter supplied
_corrections_on_landing.branch_base: the prompt said 'cut from main'. There is no main branch in this repo; origin/HEAD points to master. Corrected to master in prompts/phase_12.md.
_corrections_on_landing.nothing_else: No other change. Every [Cooper] slot, including the entire LULD band table, is left exactly as handed over.

universe.halt_scope_note: LULD pauses apply to regular trading hours. Premarket and post are computed and reported but carry no band arithmetic unless Cooper supplies parameters for them.

luld_bands._CRITICAL: THE ENVIRONMENT IS OFFLINE (D14). There is no way to fetch the LULD plan. Every parameter below MUST be supplied by Cooper from an authoritative source. The agent does NOT fill these from memory, from the data, or by inference. Escalation row 4 fires on any band parameter used that does not cite a key in this block.
luld_bands.source_document: [Cooper] - cite the document and its date
luld_bands.universe_tier_expected: [Cooper] - this universe is micro-cap; confirm the tier rather than assuming

band_table._shape: list of {price_min, price_max, band_pct} - Cooper supplies the brackets and widths

luld_bands.reference_price_rule: [Cooper] - how the reference price is computed and over what window
luld_bands.price_bracket_crossing_note: This universe's median implied price moves from ~$2.21 at T-3 to ~$4.52 at T=0 (Phase 11 A2-6). Events therefore cross price brackets DURING the event, changing their own band width. The band must be evaluated at each moment, not once per event. Report the share of events that cross a bracket.

route_1_tape_gaps.gap_threshold_reasoning: Proposed well below any plausible pause length so the DISTRIBUTION is visible before a threshold is applied. T1b reports the distribution first; the threshold is applied after.
route_1_tape_gaps.resumption_note: A gap with no prints afterwards is a session end or a delisting, not a halt. Carried as its own class.

route_2_condition_codes.dictionary_path: [Cooper] - path to a committed dictionary file, or the string 'NONE'
route_2_condition_codes.dictionary_note: Phase 11 A2-11 found `indicators` populated on 88.85% of source rows, 99.77% carrying a single code, and NO dictionary on disk - available and uninterpretable. If this resolves to NONE, route 2 produces a census only and identifies nothing. Inferring a code's meaning from its distribution is escalation row 5.

route_3_band_arithmetic.evaluate_at: every quote update, or every minute bar if quote-level proves out of budget

stage_b.authorisation_note: Set true ONLY by Cooper in writing after the T3 gate.

state_variables._rule: Every state variable must be knowable at decision time and lagged by realistic pipeline latency. CLAUDE.md standing constraint. Escalation row 7.

reopen.gap_definition: first print after resumption against last print before the gap

stage_b.ruin_thresholds_proposal_note: Expressed as a fraction of account equity, e.g. [0.01, 0.02, 0.05, 0.10]. The T5d table reports, for each, the position size at which the observed p01 adverse reopen produces that loss. It is arithmetic. The agent proposes NO position size - escalation row 15.

cooper_thresholds.row_10_scope: Events with >= 2 routes agreeing on at least one halt. Below this, a reopen distribution cannot be measured and the phase writes the feasibility finding.
cooper_thresholds.row_11_scope: Share of candidate halts identified by exactly one route. Above this, the routes do not corroborate and identification is not established.

runtime_ceilings.on_breach: hard stop; do not silently reduce the cohort or the grid

reporting.n_rule: Every posted table carries n per row. Every prose claim carries its chart filename.
reporting.description_only: No recommendations, no position size, no causal language.
reporting.units_rule: D19 - bp and cents, never one alone
reporting.distribution_rule: Reopen gap is never reported as a median alone. Full distribution and explicit left tail.
